classification.difficultyReason: Identify side roles in differently oriented right triangles and select sine, cosine or tangent. Part i requires rearranging tan(23°) = 9/i by multiplying and dividing. These are routine linked taught procedures, followed by rounding to four decimal places.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral, correct to 4 decimal places.

spec.description: Vertical left leg and horizontal bottom leg; hypotenuse slopes down to the right. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at bottom left; hypotenuse 14 cm; bottom-right angle 58 degrees; opposite leg a cm.

answer.worked:
Use sine: $a$ is opposite the reference angle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{a}{14}&=\sin58^\circ\\a&=14\sin58^\circ\\a&\approx11.8727\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal top and vertical left legs; ordinary outlines and labels black.
spec.mathematics: Top leg 18 mm; left leg b mm; right angle top left; angle 37 degrees at top right.

answer.worked:
Use tangent: $b$ is opposite and $18\text{ mm}$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{b}{18}&=\tan37^\circ\\b&=18\tan37^\circ\\b&\approx13.5640\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal top leg and vertical right leg; hypotenuse descends rightwards.
spec.mathematics: Top leg 1.2 m; right leg c m; right angle top right; angle 46 degrees at top left.

answer.worked:
Use tangent: $c$ is opposite and $1.2\text{ m}$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{c}{1.2}&=\tan46^\circ\\c&=1.2\tan46^\circ\\c&\approx1.2426\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Long narrow triangle pointing upper right. External curved pointer identifies the acute tip angle.
spec.mathematics: Short left side d cm; lower long leg 26 cm; right angle at lower left; tip angle 10 degrees.

answer.worked:
Use tangent: $d$ is opposite and $26\text{ cm}$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{d}{26}&=\tan10^\circ\\d&=26\tan10^\circ\\d&\approx4.5845\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Wide triangle with horizontal upper hypotenuse and a short sloping left side.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 6.9 cm; adjacent short side e cm; angle 75 degrees at upper left; right angle lower left.

answer.worked:
Use cosine: $e$ is adjacent and $6.9\text{ cm}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{e}{6.9}&=\cos75^\circ\\e&=6.9\cos75^\circ\\e&\approx1.7859\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal top leg and vertical left leg; rising hypotenuse from bottom left to top right.
spec.mathematics: Left leg f mm; hypotenuse 8.9 mm; top-right angle 31 degrees; right angle top left.

answer.worked:
Use sine: $f$ is opposite and $8.9\text{ mm}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{f}{8.9}&=\sin31^\circ\\f&=8.9\sin31^\circ\\f&\approx4.5838\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall triangle with vertical right leg and horizontal bottom leg.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 16 cm; bottom leg g cm; angle 27 degrees at top right; right angle bottom right.

answer.worked:
Use sine: $g$ is opposite and $16\text{ cm}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{g}{16}&=\sin27^\circ\\g&=16\sin27^\circ\\g&\approx7.2638\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal bottom hypotenuse; upper right-angle vertex near the left.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 8 m; left sloping leg h m; angle 62 degrees at bottom left; right angle at upper vertex.

answer.worked:
Use cosine: $h$ is adjacent and $8\text{ m}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{h}{8}&=\cos62^\circ\\h&=8\cos62^\circ\\h&\approx3.7558\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall triangle with vertical left leg, horizontal bottom leg and descending hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: Left leg i mm; bottom leg 9 mm; right angle bottom left; top angle 23 degrees.

answer.worked:
Use tangent: $9\text{ mm}$ is opposite and $i$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\tan23^\circ&=\frac{9}{i}\\i\tan23^\circ&=9\\i&=\frac{9}{\tan23^\circ}\\i&\approx21.2027\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal top leg and vertical right leg; diagonal hypotenuse descends rightwards.
spec.mathematics: Hypotenuse 16 cm; top-left angle 41 degrees; opposite right leg j cm; right angle top right.

answer.worked:
Use sine: $j$ is opposite and $16\text{ cm}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{j}{16}&=\sin41^\circ\\j&=16\sin41^\circ\\j&\approx10.4969\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Oblique triangle with short left leg and rightmost tip.
spec.mathematics: Short leg k mm; hypotenuse 18.6 mm; angle 72 degrees at lower left; right angle upper left.

answer.worked:
Use cosine: $k$ is adjacent and $18.6\text{ mm}$ is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{k}{18.6}&=\cos72^\circ\\k&=18.6\cos72^\circ\\k&\approx5.7477\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Narrow downward-pointing triangle with horizontal top and vertical right legs.
spec.mathematics: Top leg 4 cm; right leg ell cm; top-left angle 83 degrees; right angle top right.

answer.worked:
Use tangent: $\ell$ is opposite and $4\text{ cm}$ is adjacent.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\ell}{4}&=\tan83^\circ\\\ell&=4\tan83^\circ\\\ell&\approx32.5774\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
